user.title: Komfovent C4
user.description: Connect to a Komfovent DOMEKT unit with a C4 controller through its Ping2 gateway (or another RS-485-to-Modbus-TCP bridge).

data_description.host: IP address of the Ping2 gateway, or of whatever bridge sits in front of the unit.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port. The documented default is 502.
data_description.modbus_address: Modbus address (device id) of the unit. Behind a Ping2 it is the gateway's "Modbus ID of AHU"; a C4 wired straight to a bridge answers at the address in its register 1006, and at 254.
data_description.time_zone: The zone the controller's clock is kept in. Only change this if the unit is not where Home Assistant is.

data_description.modbus_address: Modbus address (device id) of the unit. Behind a Ping2 it is the gateway's "Modbus ID of AHU"; a C4 wired straight to a bridge answers at the address in its register 1006, and at 254.
data_description.time_zone: The zone the controller's clock is kept in. Only change this if the unit is not where Home Assistant is.

abort.already_configured: A unit at this host, port and Modbus address is already configured.

data_description.update_interval: How often to poll the unit. Every read crosses the gateway's 19200-baud serial link, so very short intervals gain little.

schedule_empty.message: The unit's own weekly schedule is empty, so it would stay off in this mode. Program the schedule on the unit's panel, or keep the mode manual and schedule the ventilation level from Home Assistant.
